# opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent (Data Source)

Kea control agent settings (Services > Kea DHCP > Control Agent).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the agent runs.
- `http_host` (String) Listen address.
- `http_port` (Number) Listen port.
- `id` (String) Always `kea_ctrl_agent`.
